'''Goblins''' are one of the most common, low-[[Combat level|level]] [[monsters]] found around [[Gielinor]]. They are popularly killed by low-level players training their [[combat]] [[skills]].

Goblins are often one of the first monsters a player will encounter, as they inhabit much of the area around [[Lumbridge]].

The single armed goblin with a blue mail (as indicated in the [[#Gallery|gallery]] below) is the only aggressive goblin found anywhere, other than the [[Goblin (GWD)|variants]] found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]s. Whenever a player is standing anywhere inside the [[Goblin Cave]] (even when outside the goblin's direct surroundings), it will yell {{overhead|Halt intruder!}}, within regular time intervals. This goblin has a wander range spanning almost the entire goblin cave, so it may attack players practically anywhere inside these caves. Other than this single goblin, any other goblin can become aggressive upon searching any of the [[Boxes (Goblin Cave)|stacked boxes]] in the cave, with one random nearby goblin being selected to become aggressive every time the boxes are searched.
